summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) to extract CipherBox's Rust code into a Cargo workspace with separate crates: crypto, core, api-client, fuse, sdk, plus desktop cleanup and CI setup.
summary.outcome: Waves 1-3 completed successfully (plans 23-01 through 23-05). Wave 4 (23-06, 23-07) was spawned but the transcript ends before confirmation. Wave 3 required a retry due to Claude usage limit interruption mid-execution.

repo: Project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with wave-based parallel plan execution via subagents
Phase 23 extracts a Cargo workspace with crates: cipherbox-crypto, cipherbox-core, cipherbox-api-client, cipherbox-fuse, cipherbox-sdk — desktop becomes a thin Tauri shell
cipherbox-fuse uses platform feature flags: macOS SMB backend, Linux FUSE, Windows — platform code is conditionally compiled
cipherbox-sdk includes KeyState with zeroize for secure key material cleanup
Desktop app previously had a local crypto/ directory and API directory, both replaced by workspace crates
162 existing desktop tests remained passing after core extraction, plus 12 new core crate tests added
Cross-language parity tests added comparing Rust vs TypeScript test vectors via 9 shared JSON files
workflow: When a Claude usage limit interruption leaves partial uncommitted work, checking crate directories vs lib.rs presence is a reliable way to assess completion state before retrying
GSD spot-check pattern: verify SUMMARY.md exists + git commits present + no '## Self-Check: FAILED' marker
Pre-wave dependency checks (verify key-links) are a gate before spawning each subsequent wave
Parallel agents in a wave can hit usage limits independently — retry requires re-spawning both, not resuming

friction: Claude usage limit hit mid-Wave 3 execution, leaving partial uncommitted work in crates/fuse/ and crates/sdk/ with no lib.rs files
Required manual 'resume' prompt from user to continue after usage reset
